provenance_note: Hand-derived from 232.0-B-4 4.1.2, 4.4.7 and 04-engines LNK-050. Model test-vectors/models/link_recv.py, written blind (TV-023) by a Claude agent from the Blue Books and docs/ only, without reading any implementation; for format only it read the COP-1 model and scenario files (cop1.py, the cop1 directory). The input scripts were chosen by hand; the expected outputs are the model's. Where the documents are silent the model refuses the case (see the README of test-vectors/link/recv/), so no scenario pins a behavior that 04 or the Blue Books leave open. The file is written by the model (--write) and never edited by hand.
